query:
SELECT id, title, slug, date, 
  LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(blocks, '$')) as block_count,
  CASE WHEN coverImageUrl IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as has_image
FROM news 
WHERE slug IN (
  'million-dollar-quartet-scr-debut',
  'making-my-scr-debut-million-dollar-quartet-2025',
  'assisting-the-play-that-goes-wrong',
  'assisting-tom-buderwitz-the-play-that-goes-wrong',
  '40-productions-at-okoboji-summer-theatre'
)
ORDER BY slug, block_count DESC;
